Name: Skull Cavern Magic Door
Author: Jolamods
Description:
Skip the desert trip. Craft a reusable door with the original Skull Cavern design, place it indoors or outdoors, and teleport straight to the entrance lobby. At the original cavern door, choose to enter Skull Cavern or return to your magic door. Both trips use the mini-obelisk's effects and sound. No fuel or charges needed.

[b]SPANISH, RUSSIAN AND CHINESE TRANSLATIONS AVAILABE.[/b]

[b]Mod has 2 versions:[/b]
[b]Standard:[/b] Mining 10, Skull Key and the Wizard's magical construction book unlocked. Costs 20 Iridium Bars, 1 Prismatic Shard, 100 Hardwood, 50 Solar Essence, 50 Void Essence and 10 Battery Packs.

[b]Easy:[/b] Mining 3 and Skull Key. Costs 5 Iron Bars, 50 Wood, 25 Stone and 5 Solar Essence.
Both versions work the same. Install only one.

[b]One door per save[/b]
You can craft one door per save and pick it up to move it. Existing doors are kept when updating; if you already have several, use the one you want to return to. Your return door must be placed with a clear space nearby.

[b]Installation[/b]
Requires Stardew Valley 1.6.14+ and SMAPI 4.5.2+. Extract Standard or Easy into Mods. To switch versions, overwrite the same folder, including config.json.

[b]Translations[/b]
English is included. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53364]Spanish[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53365]Russian[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53366]Simplified Chinese[/url] text packs work with Standard and Easy. Install the main mod first, then extract your translation into Mods and merge the existing folder. Your game language selects it automatically.

Normal placement rules apply. In co-op, everyone needs the mod and only the host can craft the door. Co-op has not been runtime-tested. Remove placed doors before uninstalling.

Original artwork and sounds are loaded from your game. The cover is an AI-generated promotional illustration; the gallery includes real in-game screenshots.
